pages.text:
Fat Cat sees a bee.
BUZZ
Fat Cat flees up a tree.
"I don't like bees!" yelps Fat Cat.

"I don't like bees
and I don't like
trees."
"I don't like bees or trees."
"Are you stuck?"
shouts Big Pig.
"Bad luck!" shouts Big Pig.

Fat Cat
groans.
"I am stuck.
It is bad luck,"
she moans.
The tree bends....

The tree bends...
...and the
nest drops
off the end.

The nest drops,
with a plop, on
top of Big Pig.
"Like my new hat, Fat Cat?"
"Good catch!"
yelps Fat Cat.
Fat Cat lands in a sandy patch.
"I must help the eggs to hatch."

Next day,
Fat Cat will
not play.
"Play with
me!" says
Big Pig.
"Not today," says Fat Cat on her mat.

"Bake a cake with me,"
says Jake Snake.
"Not today," says Fat Cat on her mat.
"Let's run in the sun for fun," says Ted.
"Not today," says Fat Cat on her mat.

"You are lazy," says Big Pig.
"You are crazy," says Jake Snake.
"You are no fun," says Ted.
"Shh!" says
Fat Cat.
"Stay away,"
says Fat Cat.

She hops up
off her mat.
"It's the eggs
from the nest!"
says Big Pig.
"See the
chicks hatch."
